fees.description:
This fee is set by your distributor and may vary. Please visit your distributor's website to find out the current fee.
We reserve the right to and will notify you if we change or impose additional fees or charges in relation to your energy supply. Fees and charges charged by the distributor are published on the AusNet website and may change from time to time.
Next business day reconnection fee. This fee is passed through from your distributor and may vary. Please visit your distributor's website to find out the current fee.
A fee for paying a bill over the counter at Australia Post. This fee will appear in the next bill after payment.
A fee to cover the cost of printing and mailing the bill. This fee will appear in the next bill after payment.
